text.text: For a small business that bills clients and pays its own costs. Mark invoices Sent, Paid or Overdue and log every cost. The dashboard shows what is owed and what you spent by category.
A reminder is a service to the client who forgot, not a threat. Keep the same warm tone on day 1 as on day 14 and let the dates carry the weight.
Day 1 late: friendly reminder with the invoice attached.
Day 7 late: phone call or direct message.
Day 14 late: written notice of the late-payment terms.
Day 30 late: pause new work until the balance is cleared.
Switch an invoice to Overdue the first day it is late so it shows up on the dashboard.
Write the date and way of each reminder in the invoice row notes.
Note any new payment date the client gives.
When money arrives, use Mark paid so the dashboard clears it.
Close the month on the same day each month. It takes twenty minutes when the invoices and receipts are already in the tables.
Record the amount reserved for taxes this month
Open the This month view on expenses and the Paid this month view on invoices. Note both totals at the bottom of this page so you can compare months later.
